brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday characterized efforts to criticize settlers as a "smear" campaign, according to Middle East Eye. His remarks came as an attack by Israeli settlers on a French mayor faced international condemnation.

The incident has drawn rebuke from foreign officials and international observers, though Netanyahu's specific comments suggested he views scrutiny of settler conduct as a coordinated effort to delegitimize the settler movement rather than legitimate accountability for individual acts of violence.

title: Netanyahu calls settler criticism a smear campaign amid French mayor attack
